name: Nowlun
description:
As the first digital freight forwarder in the MENA region, Nowlun is on a mission to become the go-to logistics platform for the entire supply chain ecosystem. Since its founding, the company has expanded into Egypt and Saudi Arabia and is now poised for further regional and global growth.

Nowlun has redefined the logistics industry by integrating with all major shipping lines to offer instant, transparent, and competitive ocean freight rates for both imports and exports. This seamless access to real-time pricing allows businesses to make faster, more informed decisions, unlock incredible cost-savings opportunities, and simplify the complexities of shipping while providing them with the data they need in real time.

jobs.title: Sales Executive-Saudi Nationality Only
jobs.description:
Nowlun, the pioneering digital freight forwarder in the MENA region, is on a mission to transform logistics by providing instant, transparent, and competitive ocean freight rates through fully integrated solutions with major shipping lines. Our goal is to become the preferred logistics platform across the supply chain ecosystem, empowering businesses in Saudi Arabia and beyond with real-time pricing that unlocks significant savings.

We are looking for a passionate and results-driven Sales Executive, exclusively for Saudi nationals, to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in fostering new client relationships and expanding our market footprint.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and target potential clients in the logistics and freight forwarding sector.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to enhance satisfaction and retention.
  • Conduct market research to explore new opportunities and stay ahead of industry trends.
  • Create and present compelling sales pitches to attract prospective customers.
  • Work closely with the operational team to ensure seamless service delivery to clients.
  • Monitor sales metrics and strategize to achieve targeted goals.
  • Participate in industry networking events to elevate brand presence and foster connections.

Requirements

  • 1-3 years of relevant experience in sales or business development, ideally within the logistics or freight forwarding industry.
  • Strong knowledge of B2B sales techniques and strategies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to establish and nurture client relationships effectively.
  • Results-oriented with a proactive, self-motivated demeanor.
  • Experience with CRM software is an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, or a comparable field is preferred.
  • Must hold Saudi nationality.

Benefits

  • Join a team of exceptional talents and collaborate with inspiring colleagues who challenge and motivate you to excel.
  • Monthly Sales Commission
  • Company Stock Options (we hire partners)
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Channel your passion into meaningful work at an organization committed to driving impact and unlocking the potential of an underexplored region.
  • Embrace opportunities to learn, grow, and expand your skills every single day.

If you are a results-oriented sales leader with a passion for logistics and a proven track record of success, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Saudi Arabia - Logistics Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Nowlun, the first digital freight forwarder in the MENA region, is redefining logistics by providing instant, transparent, and competitive ocean freight rates via integrated solutions with all major shipping lines. Our mission is to become the top logistics platform for the entire supply chain ecosystem, supporting businesses in Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and beyond with real-time pricing that unlocks significant cost-savings opportunities.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a Sales Manager who will play a crucial role in strengthening client relationships and driving new business opportunities. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to simplify shipping complexities and provide clients with real-time data, we invite you to join our innovative team at Nowlun and contribute to the future of logistics.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor a team of sales professionals to achieve and exceed sales targets.
  • Develop and implement effective sales strategies to drive revenue growth.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to ensure long-term partnerships.
  • Identify and qualify new sales leads, converting them into paying customers.
  • Conduct product presentations and effectively communicate Nowlun's value proposition.
  • Prepare and deliver sales reports, analyzing data to identify trends and areas for improvement.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within existing client accounts to drive revenue growth.
  • Utilize data analytics to provide strategic insights and recommendations to clients regarding their shipping and logistics needs.
  • Conduct regular account reviews to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and discuss future goals with clients.
  • Develop and implement account engagement strategies that align with Nowlun's overall business objectives.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and developments to position Nowlun as a leader in digital freight forwarding.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in sales leadership or a senior sales role.
  • Strong understanding of ocean freight processes and pricing structures.
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and achieving revenue growth.
  • Strong understanding of B2B sales methodologies and best practices.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with clients and colleagues.
  • Experience in logistics or freight forwarding is a MUST.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport with clients.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights to clients.
  • Goal-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Proficiency in CRM software.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, or a related field is preferred.

Benefits

  • Join a team of exceptional talents and collaborate with inspiring colleagues who challenge and motivate you to excel.
  • Monthly Sales Commission
  • Company Stock Options (we hire partners)
  • Private Health Insurance
  • Channel your passion into meaningful work at an organization committed to driving impact and unlocking the potential of an underexplored region.
  • Embrace opportunities to learn, grow, and expand your skills every single day.

If you are a results-oriented sales leader with a passion for logistics and a proven track record of success, we encourage you to apply!
